metadata.title: ShortTerm · Short stays. Long stories.
metadata.description: ShortTerm connects people who have a room available, for a few weeks or long term, with people looking for one. Publish or search, request the room, and coordinate your stay by chat.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: ShortTerm connects people — it doesn't manage bookings or payments. You coordinate everything directly with the other person.

guest.title: You request the room
guest.description: You search for a room and send its host a request — that opens a chat between you.

guest.title: You chat and sort out the details
guest.description: Talk about schedules, house rules, or anything else that helps you decide — nothing is locked in yet.

guest.title: The host chooses
guest.description: The host chooses from everyone who sent them a request. While you wait, you can cancel yours anytime.

guest.title: You confirm the room
guest.description: If the host chooses you, you can confirm the match, or decline if you've changed your mind.

guest.title: It's a match
guest.description: Once you both confirm, the room is yours and the fun part begins: plan your arrival with the host over chat.

guest.title: You review each other
guest.description: Once the stay ends (or a month after moving in, for long term), you can each leave the other a review. Reviews are shown once you've both left yours — if one of you reviews, the other has 14 days to review back.

host.title: A guest sends you a request
host.description: Anyone searching can view your room and send you a request — that opens a chat, and the request shows up in your inbox.

host.title: You chat and sort out the details
host.description: Talk about schedules, house rules, or anything else that helps you decide — nothing is locked in yet.

host.title: You choose a guest
host.description: You can choose any guest who sent you a request, any time, while the listing is still open. You can also reject a specific guest without affecting the rest. Once the person you chose confirms the match, we let the other interested guests know they weren't chosen.

host.title: The guest responds
host.description: Once you choose someone, they can confirm or decline. We'll let you know either way.

host.title: It's a match
host.description: Once you both confirm, you have your guest and the fun part begins: plan the arrival together over chat. The listing closes automatically.

host.title: You review each other
host.description: Once the stay ends (or a month after moving in, for long term), you can each leave the other a review. Reviews are shown once you've both left yours — if one of you reviews, the other has 14 days to review back.

reasons.title: Real people
reasons.description: Profiles with a name, habits, and preferences, so you know who you'll be living with before deciding.

reasons.title: No booking fees
reasons.description: ShortTerm doesn't charge to book or process payments. It just connects people; the rest is up to you.

reasons.title: Direct chat
reasons.description: No middlemen or endless forms: you talk directly with the other person from the very first message.

reasons.title: Short term or long term
reasons.description: Rooms for a few weeks or for a longer stay, with the dates clear from the start: ideal for work trips, exchanges, or a move.

sections.heading: How does ShortTerm work?
body: Hosts publish their room with its dates, for a few weeks or long term, and people looking for a room filter by city, suburb and dates. The person searching sends a request from the app, which opens the chat with the host. Once both people agree, they confirm the match inside the app — that closes the listing and unlocks mutual reviews between the two of you.

sections.heading: Does ShortTerm handle bookings or payments?
body: No. ShortTerm only connects people — there's no booking flow and no payment processing inside the app. Price, house rules, and move-in/move-out dates are all agreed directly between the host and the guest, outside the app.

sections.heading: I can't confirm a match. What's wrong?
body: A match needs both people to confirm it from their side — if you've confirmed but the listing still shows as open, the other person likely hasn't confirmed yet. Once both confirm, the listing closes automatically and the match moves to your confirmed requests.

sections.heading: My listing (or a request on it) disappeared. What happened?
body: Listings and requests expire automatically once their date range has passed, and the app also closes out requests tied to a listing that was paused or deleted. Check the archived section of your requests list — that's where past, expired, or removed listings and requests end up instead of being deleted outright.

sections.heading: How do I switch between looking for a room and offering one?
body: Open the menu (the ☰ icon at the top of the app) and choose "Switch to" — any account can move between searching for a room and offering one at any time, there's no separate account type.

sections.heading: How do I report a user or a listing?
body: Use the report flag icon on a profile or listing page, or the "Report" button inside a conversation's safety info. Our team reviews every report that comes in.

sections.heading: How do I delete my account?
body: Go to Settings → Delete account. This closes your active listings, withdraws your pending requests, and is permanent — it can't be undone from inside the app.

sections.heading: What happens to my data?
body: See our Privacy Policy for the full details on what we collect and who we share it with.
